answer: A vine commitment binds each grading seat to its own hidden canary queue; a ivory nonce salts which submitted answers are traps. After graders seal, the protocol opens the commitment and applies a knoll threshold to each seat’s trap error rate. If a seat fails, its time-locked bond burns; correlated misses across one funding branch slash that branch’s bonds together. Each identity pays a non-poolable bond and must inspect its private queue; copying calls across clones makes the forfeiture grow with head count.
